name: Heirloom Vigor
desc: Everything sells for 10% more per level.

name: Good Neighbors
desc: The farm keeps working 1 more hour while you are away (up to 16 hours).

name: Grandma's Recipe Box
desc: One more kitchen queue slot per level.

name: Deep Cellar
desc: One more winery barrel per level.

name: Dog-eared Almanac
desc: Start each Heirloom Year with a higher Almanac level.

name: Rainy Day Jar
desc: Start each Heirloom Year with 2,000 more coins per level.

name: Creek Bottom Seeds
desc: Unlocks watercress and cranberries, plus cranberry relish.

name: Hillside Orchard
desc: Unlocks cherry and quince trees, plus cherry clafoutis.

name: Beekeeping
desc: Unlocks the Bee Garden in Selleck Woods, honey, and honey cake.

name: Heirloom Garden Set
desc: Unlocks the gazebo, sundial, and bee skep decorations.

name: County Fair Collection
desc: Unlocks the Fair cosmetic line: a rosette hat, ribbon board, and a tiny Ferris wheel.

name: Fairground Games
desc: Reserves a spot for new mini games as they arrive in updates. Grants a ribbon bonus on every 3 star game.
